前記第１ユーザ群の一部と共通する共通ユーザ群である第２ユーザ群のユーザごとの属性を示す第２データを有する第２テーブルデータ、および、前記第１テーブルデータにおける前記共通ユーザ群についての前記第１データに基づいて、前記第２テーブルデータ内の前記共通ユーザ群の欠損データを推定する第２推定モデルを構築する第２学習部と、
前記第１推定モデルと前記第２推定モデルとに基づいて、前記共通ユーザ群を除く前記第１ユーザ群についての前記第２データの値を推定する推定部と、を備える、推定装置。
blocks.output_text: a first learning unit that constructs a first estimation model for estimating missing data in first table data based on the first table data, the first table data being constituted by first data indicating an attribute of each user of a first user group; a second learning unit that constructs a second estimation model for estimating missing data of a second user group in second table data based on the second table data and the first data of the second user group in the first table data, the second user group being a common user group that is common to a part of the first user group; and an estimation unit that estimates a value of the second data for the first user group excluding the common user group based on the first estimation model and the second estimation model.
